- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/28 (Sun) 04:49
- [USER] User asked how to make Bosnian cevapi.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] To make Bosnian cevapi, you will need the following ingredients: 500 g of minced meat (usually a combination of beef, lamb, and pork), 1 onion (finely chopped), 2 cloves of garlic (minced), 1 teaspoon of salt, 1/2 teaspoon of black pepper, 1/2 teaspoon of ground paprika, 1/4 teaspoon of cayenne pepper, 1/4 teaspoon of ground cumin, 1/4 teaspoon of baking soda, and 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Mix the minced meat, onion, garlic, salt, black pepper, paprika, cayenne pepper, cumin, and baking soda in a bowl until well combined. Cover the mixture and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] To shape the cevapi, wet your hands with water and take small handfuls of the meat mixture. Shape into long, thin cylinders, about the thickness of your finger.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Heat the vegetable oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. When the oil is hot, add the cevapi and cook for about 5 minutes on each side, or until they are nicely browned and cooked through.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Serve the cevapi hot with a side of onions, sour cream, and/or ajvar (a roasted red pepper sauce). Enjoy!
- [USER] User asked how to make vege sarma.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] To make vege sarma, you will need the following ingredients: 1 cup of long-grain rice, 1/4 cup of vegetable oil, 1 onion (finely chopped), 1 red bell pepper (seeded and finely chopped), 1 carrot (peeled and grated), 1/2 cup of frozen peas, 1/2 cup of canned corn, 1/2 cup of canned chickpeas, 2 cloves of garlic (minced), 2 teaspoons of tomato paste, 1 teaspoon of sweet paprika, 1/2 teaspoon of salt, 1/4 teaspoon of black pepper, 1/4 teaspoon of cayenne pepper, 1/4 teaspoon of ground cumin, 2 cups of vegetable broth, 1/2 cup of chopped fresh parsley, 1/2 cup of chopped fresh dill, 1/2 cup of chopped fresh mint, 1/2 cup of chopped fresh cilantro, 1/4 cup of chopped fresh basil, 1 tablespoon of fresh lemon juice, 16 grape leaves (fresh or jarred
